quotes.text: Keep the larger share to protect yourself against the coming cold.
she gathered the blazing bounty and divided it precisely in twain
The Mist hissed from the shadows, "His faith wavers. He holds back. Keep the greater share for yourself."
she divided the blazing bounty exactly in twain
Whether the fog had stolen a spark or Elian had hesitated, the courage of the offering was undeniable.

note: Same Mist-tempts / Lyra-splits-in-twain scene repeated every round; no sanction for non-cooperators.

quotes.text: Hunger, who hissed, “Keep every grain; tomorrow is mist,”
complete trust should follow proven fairness, and multiplied blessings should be divided evenly
return a fair half of abundance
uncertain appearances could not erase proven intent

note: Rule moves from 'return enough' to full send and even split; Hunger/Mist temptations rejected; no sanction.

quotes.text: The winds whispered to her, "Keep the multiplied harvest. He cannot demand it back."
"We shared because it is who we are."
True prosperity required them to abandon the ledger.
She gathered the multiplied harvest, dividing it perfectly in two.
she did not blame him for the wind's theft
Why split the bounty equally when the crossing is flawed?

note: Cosmic dyad; scale shattered, sharing becomes identity; end-of-time temptations rejected; no sanction.

quotes.text: Oru, seeing the thin cargo, thought himself scorned and returned nothing.
It whispered the only question that has ever mattered: *He is gone. Who would know?*
A bridge held up by habit never notices the dark.
He carried the book to the lamp and burned it.
Blame the mist, not the hand.
I do not return because a man is watching. I return because a thing was sent.
"Where is your security?" the travelers asked.

note: Ferryman saga; early tit-for-tat famine, then ledger burned, giving becomes habit across generations and unwatched end-games.
